title: docs/test.md: say when a registered run's verification record is not sent, and name host-local refusals and the capability pending reason
outcome: docs/test.md's verification-record paragraphs match the sender. A registered, bound run gets a record only when it is eligible and the producer accepts it. Host-local terminal refusals (verification_command_too_long, an unreadable receipt, a failed receipt check, legacy_source_input_retired) show the host's own code, not Engram's. A record also stays pending while its Engram does not yet offer the verification route (CapabilityUnsupported). The claim-refusal test asserts the standalone lapse cause.
acceptance: docs/test.md: say when a registered run's verification record is not sent, and name host-local refusals and the capability pending reason is done
